[d8] Fix use-after-free in Shell::ResetOnProfileEndListener(..)

Fixed: 486383560
Change-Id: I1e6bc7bb1a18687a93b6a6bbdbd0f1f4800d5b63
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/7594689
Commit-Queue: Igor Sheludko <ishell@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Patrick Thier <pthier@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Patrick Thier <pthier@chromium.org>
Auto-Submit: Igor Sheludko <ishell@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#105372}
agent_reasoning: The bug-introducing commit added an early return in Shell::ResetOnProfileEndListener for the inspector-enabled case, but placed it before the unconditional profiler_end_callback_.erase(isolate) call. This caused the map entry (keyed by raw Isolate* and holding v8::Global handles tied to that isolate) to never be erased when the inspector was enabled, leading to a stale entry referencing a soon-to-be-destroyed isolate - a use-after-free. The fix simply reorders the code: erase the map entry unconditionally first, then perform the inspector-enabled early return check before the D8Console-specific teardown. I applied this exact reordering to src/d8/d8.cc (the only affected file), matching the fix commit's logic while adapting to the fact that this snapshot doesn't yet have the mutex guard around the map access.
